input.question: When was the Dallas County Courthouse built?

documents.text: The $20,000 building was located on the town square. The present courthouse of white Bedford stone was completed on July 10, 1850, by the contracting firm of Jones, Rowson and Son. The cost was $109,000. The architects were Proudfoot and Bird with John Olson as the superintendent of construction. A crowd of 2,000 people attended the dedication in September of 1850.
